flow.lore: The bearers walk the old processional roads at dusk, each carrying a lantern that gave up its light long ago.

creature.name: Cut Bearer
entries: The bearer knows the location of every open flame within 60 feet of it, even through walls.
A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the bearer must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have its light sources reduced by one step until the end of its next turn.
The bearer has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in dim light or darkness.
The bearer makes two Lantern Swing attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
The bearer exhales a cloud of soot in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
The bearer extinguishes a nonmagical flame within 30 feet of it.
When the bearer takes fire damage, it reduces that damage by 5 (1d6 + 2).
